resumen: Standing facing a high pulley, you pull a rope towards your face with the elbows high, spreading the hands apart at the end. It works the back of the shoulder and the area between the shoulder blades.
ejecucion: Set the pulley at face height or slightly higher and hold the rope by its ends, palms facing in. If there is no rope, a short handle gripped overhand will do.
Step back until your arms are straight and the cable is taut.
Pull towards your face with your elbows high, at shoulder height, opening them out to the sides, and spread your hands at the end so they finish beside your ears.
Return by straightening your arms under control, without letting the cable pull you forward.
If your elbows drop below your shoulders as you pull, lower the weight.
matices: There is a single study, in ten men and using a computer model rather than measuring the muscle: it estimated a rear deltoid force similar to reverse flyes and higher than in the dumbbell row. It is also often used for the shoulder external rotators, which this muscle map does not draw.
